restaurantName: Tir a Môr at voco St David's Cardiff
bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea at Tir a Môr at voco St David's Cardiff. With views across Cardiff Bay waterfront, this is an Afternoon Tea experience you don't want to miss. Grab a pair of binoculars and discover the hidden gems along the stunning bay.  Afternoon Tea is served in the restaurant and bar and is the perfect place for celebrating special occasions or an overdue treat.  The chefs at Tir a Môr have added a Welsh touch to the traditional Afternoon Tea. Featuring a selection of sandwiches, scones and sweet treats, the menu pays homage to the heritage of Wales while putting a unique twist on the timeless Afternoon Tea classics.  Begin your experience with a selection of sandwiches from Camarthenshire ham and Welsh grain mustard to Snowdonia Black Bomber and onion chutney. End on a sweet note with a White chocolate and hedgerow berry tea cake, raspberry tartlet with Aberffraw crumb, a timeless Victoria sandwich and a chocolate orange sphere.
pageTitle: Tir a Môr at voco St David's Cardiff
